name: Electricity Life Support Concession
summary: Yearly payment towards electricity for Queenslanders using a home oxygen concentrator or kidney dialysis machine.
key: $1,063.30 per year for each oxygen concentrator, or $712.07 per year for each kidney dialysis machine.
who: Oxygen concentrator users must get the machine free through MASS and hold an eligible card, such as a Health Care Card
Kidney dialysis users must get a home machine free through a Queensland Health hospital
how: Complete the Electricity Life Support Concession application form
catches: CPAP machine users are not eligible.

evidence.quote: $1,063.30 per year for each oxygen concentrator
